resources.string: Lets VoiceLock detect when the phone has just been unlocked so it can show the VoiceLock gate before anything else becomes visible.
Say your trigger phrase to lock the phone instantly.

VoiceLock lets you lock your phone instantly just by speaking a secret phrase — even while someone else is holding it. Everything runs on-device. VoiceLock never requests the INTERNET permission, so it is physically incapable of sending your voice, your passcode, or anything else off this phone. You can verify that yourself by inspecting the APK.
VoiceLock needs the microphone to listen for your trigger phrase. Audio is processed in memory only — it is never recorded to disk or sent anywhere.
Allow VoiceLock to lock the screen
Device admin disabled — VoiceLock can no longer lock your phone on trigger.
VoiceLock needs Device Administrator access to lock your screen the instant it hears your trigger phrase.
Turn on the VoiceLock accessibility service so the hardened gate appears the instant the phone is unlocked after a trigger. Find \"VoiceLock\" in the list on the next screen and turn it on.

Some phones aggressively kill background listeners to save battery. Exempting VoiceLock keeps it listening reliably. If your phone maker has an extra \"auto-start\" or \"protected app\" toggle (common on Samsung, Xiaomi, and OnePlus), enable that too — see the README for manufacturer-specific steps.
Choose a short phrase only you would say, like \"lock lock lock\". Record it a few times so VoiceLock can recognize your voice reliably, then test detection before you arm the app.
This is a second, separate passcode. Even someone who knows your phone\'s regular unlock PIN cannot get past the VoiceLock gate without it. Choose 4–8 digits.
If you ever forget your VoiceLock passcode, this can help you recover it. You can also always disable third-party apps by booting into Safe Mode — see the README.
Arm VoiceLock to start listening for your trigger phrase.
Higher sensitivity catches your phrase more reliably but may trigger on similar-sounding words.
Pause listening briefly after a successful unlock
